about_the_game:
For the last 3 decades, the little hamlet of VeilWood has been isolated from the rest of the world by the sprawling mist. Prolonged exposure to the haze has twisted the local wildlife into bizarre beings that threaten the town. Solve the mysteries of the town and investigate the cause behind the haze distorting the region or grow complacent as the new town farmer.

  • Grow crops: Cultivate over 20 unique crops, each with their own growing conditions and effects.

  • Engage with diverse creatures: Protect yourself and your harvest from over 15 unique creatures, each with variants that offer unique twists on their behavior.

  • Solve various puzzles: Beneath the town lies a long-forgotten labyrinth, housing various complex puzzles and secrets. Use what you find (or grow) above to help overcome the obstacles of The Catacombs

  • Defend your estate: With only your garden tools and a few bullets, protecting your harvest becomes a blend of thoughtful structure placement and first-person combat.

  • Decorate your estate: Make your farm unique through the use of various vanity and decor options.

  • Pets!: Become acquainted and bond with a pet; Each one offering unique abilities.

  • Catch bugs: VeilWood is home to a vast amount of bugs to catch.

  • Care for your own Critters: Not all of the fauna is so bad. Raise them as your own to reap their benefits.

  • Complete quests: Be the town's little errand boy and increase in their favor.

  • Play at your own pace: VeilWood's difficulty dynamically scales with your farm size. Up for a challenge? See how you can maximize profits each night.

  • Various game modes: Want to test your farming and strategy prowess? Try a hand at Survival Mode, where you are tasked with meeting a constantly increasing money threshold. If fast paced decision making and strict time management is not your style, try Cozy Mode: A relaxed difficulty option for those who want a more casual experience.

name: VeilWood
short_description: Protect your farm from twisted creatures, explore new areas, and put an end to the Azure Haze in this first person real time strategy dark farming sim.
